en.bdb: It is always bad to imitate evil

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈ ਖਾਜੂਰੀ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਚੜੑਹਿ ਖਾਜੂਰੀ ਝੜਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: pai khaajooree jeeveeaai chaR(h)h khaajooree jhaRau na koiee|

en.bdb: Surviving the fall from the palm tree does not mean that one should climb the tree to fall from it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਨ ਮਾਰੀਐ ਉਝੜ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਚੰਗਾ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: aujhaR piaa na maareeaai ujhaR raahu na cha(n)gaa hoiee|

en.bdb: Even if one is not killed in desolete places and ways, moving on deserted places is not safe.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਪ ਖਾਧਾ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਪੁ ਨ ਫੜੀਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਵਿਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: je sap khaadhaa ubare sap na faReeaai a(n)t vigoiee|

en.bdb: One may survive even when bitten by a sanke even then catching the sanke will be harmful ultimately.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਹਣਿ ਵਹੰਦਾ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਤੁਲਹੇ ਡੁਬਿ ਮਰੈ ਭਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: vahan vaha(n)dhaa nikalai vin tulahe ddub marai bhaloiee|

en.bdb: Getting washed away by the current of river if someone comes out of it alone, even then in entering the river without a raft there is more possibility of drowning.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਾਣੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: patit udhaaran aakheeaai virateehaan jaan jaanoiee|

en.bdb: People of all inclinations know very well that God is liberator of the fallen ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaaubhagat gurmat hai dhuramat dharageh lahai na ddoiee|

en.bdb: Precept of the Guru (Gurmat) is the loving devotion and the people having evil intellect do not get shelter in the court of the Lord.
The deeds done in life are the only companions in the end.
